item.title: Jackson’s spark helps Blue Springs basketball rally past Lee’s Summit North
item.description: Blue Springs boys basketball coach Adam Jones knows how valuable junior Devin Jackson is to his team even if it’s not evident by looking at the stat sheet. Jackson’s spark, Kenny Woodard’s shooting and a strong defensive effort in the second half added up to a 64-59 come-from-behind Suburban Gold Conference victory over visiting Lee’s Summit North Tuesday night.
